name: machine-guard
description: Memory, swap and GPU on the status line and a machine_status tool for Claude; refuses heavy local jobs (training, inference, rendering, Docker) while memory is critical or the Mac is reserved with /busy.

sampleSeconds.title: Sample every (seconds)
sampleSeconds.description: How often memory and swap are read from the kernel's counters; the GPU every third time, and less often while the Mac is slow. One session samples and the others share it.

blockOnCritical.title: Block heavy jobs when memory is critical
blockOnCritical.description: Refuse heavy local jobs while macOS reports critical memory pressure. Off: only warn.

busyHours.title: Default /busy length (hours)
busyHours.description: How long /busy reserves the Mac when no duration is given.

extraHeavy.title: Also heavy (regex)
extraHeavy.description: A regular expression for more commands to treat as heavy, e.g. overnight_|nightly_run\.sh
